Company Description: Vidlexinfo LLC is a growing business consulting and staffing company focused on building effective, long-term partnerships with clients. The company aims to be a single-window solution provider, addressing diverse business requirements through highly trained and qualified professionals. Vidlexinfo prioritizes client needs and supports business growth from “better” to “best” by delivering value-driven services. Guided by a vision to lead in productivity and customer satisfaction, the organization is committed to going the extra mile. Its mission centers on understanding client business ideologies and implementing result-driven, technology-savvy processes.
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced US Immigration Executive with 3-5 years to manage end-to-end employment-based immigration processes for our organization. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience handling various work visa categories, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Requests for Evidence (RFEs), Labor Condition Applications (LCAs), prevailing wage requirements, occupation code classifications, and complete immigration documentation. This role requires strong organizational skills, a thorough understanding of U.S. immigration regulations, and the ability to coordinate effectively with attorneys, employees, HR, recruiters, and government agencies.
Manage the complete lifecycle of employment-based immigration cases from initiation through approval.
Coordinate and process work visa petitions, including H-1B, H-1B Transfers, H-1B Amendments, H-1B Extensions, and other employment-based visa categories.
Handle end-to-end PERM Labor Certification processes, including document collection, recruitment coordination, audit file maintenance, and filing support.
Prepare and coordinate I-140 Immigrant Petitions, ensuring accuracy and timely submission of supporting documentation.
Draft, review, and submit Labor Condition Applications (LCAs) while ensuring compliance with Department of Labor regulations.
Interpret Prevailing Wage Determinations (PWDs), wage levels, and Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) codes for appropriate job classifications.
Coordinate with immigration attorneys on case preparation, filing strategies, and legal documentation.
Manage and respond to Requests for Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and audit requests by gathering supporting documentation and preparing response packages.
Maintain accurate immigration records, employee files, case trackers, and compliance documentation.
Ensure adherence to USCIS, Department of Labor (DOL), and Department of State immigration regulations and filing deadlines.
Track case progress and provide regular status updates to employees, hiring managers, HR, and leadership.
Review immigration documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance before submission.
Support employees throughout the immigration process by answering questions and providing timely guidance.
Assist with public access file (PAF) preparation and maintenance for H-1B compliance.
Monitor changes in U.S. immigration laws, policies, and procedures and recommend process improvements.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience managing employment-based U.S. immigration cases.
Strong understanding of USCIS, Department of Labor (DOL), and employment-based immigration regulations.
Experience handling PERM Labor Certification, I-140 petitions, and employment-based visa processing.
Hands-on experience drafting LCAs and working with Prevailing Wage Determinations and wage levels.
Knowledge of SOC occupation codes and job classification requirements.
Experience preparing documentation for RFEs, audits, and other immigration-related requests.
Familiarity with immigration case management systems and document management tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Experience working with immigration attorneys or corporate immigration teams.
Experience with immigration compliance reporting and internal audits.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing strict deadlines.
Familiarity with E-Verify, I-9 compliance, and employment eligibility verification processes.
